concept.title: Companionship and befriending visits
concept.shortdesc: Regular company, social visits or sitting services for someone who is isolated or needs a reassuring presence, usually at home.

keywords.keyword: someone to visit me at home

conbody.note: Draft category. The name and definition were written by a language model from a clustering of real service descriptions, and no person has reviewed them.

ul.li: practical help and home help alongside visits: see (main focus is practical support, not company)
general care services: belongs in a neighbouring group that is not yet a category (personal or complex care rather than companionship)
general unspecified support: belongs in a neighbouring group that is not yet a category (no companionship element)
